notes.title: Multilanguage Update
notes.notes:
Musicmenia - Multilanguage Update

New Features:


 Text Translation Support for New Languages: French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean have been added. This update only covers text translation, voiceovers are still available only in English and Spanish.


Improved Keyboard Shortcuts:


 Tab: Player menu and statistics.
 1: Main menu.
 2: Decks.
 3: Collection.
 4: Packs.
 5: Shop.
 Escape: Options.
 Spacebar: Open packs.


Improvements and Fixes:


 Optimization of translations.
 Minor bug fixes.
 General performance enhancements.


Report Issues:
If you encounter translation errors or have suggestions, report them here: Localization Bug Report Forum
